name: file-manager
description: Local organizer for similar photos and videos

scripts.dist:win: npm run verify:media -- win && npm run build && electron-builder --win nsis --x64 --publish never && node scripts/collect-installers.mjs win
scripts.dist:mac: npm run verify:media -- mac && npm run build && electron-builder --mac dmg --x64 --publish never && node scripts/collect-installers.mjs mac
scripts.dist:linux: npm run verify:media -- linux && npm run build && electron-builder --linux AppImage --x64 --publish never && node scripts/collect-installers.mjs linux
